target_basis.explicit: A first-clear duration is stated directly in an authored level or puzzle document.
target_basis.operative: An existing project-wide workflow establishes the duration as the current production standard.
target_basis.planning: A provisional production target introduced here; playtests may revise it without changing canon.

authored_metrics.meaningful_active_seconds: Time spent traversing, exploring, planning, deciding, interacting, or executing a hazard. Passive waits and non-interactive presentation do not count.
authored_metrics.total_play_seconds: First-clear elapsed play time, including presentation and unavoidable inactive time, but excluding pause-menu time.
authored_metrics.max_dead_gap_seconds: Longest continuous interval in which the player has no useful decision or input available.
authored_metrics.max_single_mode_seconds: Longest uninterrupted interval spent in one play mode, such as pure walking, pure dialogue, or repeating one interaction.
authored_metrics.decision_count: Count of consequential decisions that can change route, cost, risk, information, or resource state.
authored_metrics.branch_count: Count of authored route, strategy, or optional-exploration branches available on first clear.
authored_metrics.category_seconds: Mutually exclusive meaningful-active time buckets. Their sum must equal meaningful_active_seconds.
